# Radoslav Radev Advises Longer Holds On Mini Progressions Between Planche Progressions To Skip Potential Injuries

Radoslav Radev advises mini progressions between the planche progressions, held longer than two seconds, if you want to skip potential injuries. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:21]

## Details

- His advice, if you want to skip potential injuries, is to have mini progressions between the progressions. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:21]
- He says not to hold just two seconds on a mini progression but, let's say, 6, 7, 8, 9 seconds, 10 seconds. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:27]
- He says the transition will then be much easier and you are not risking that much. [src: vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:36]

## Evidence

- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:21 (Radoslav Radev): "My advice for you, if you want to skip potential injuries, to have mini progressions between the progressions"
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:27 (Radoslav Radev): "and not just to hold two seconds on the mini progression, but to hold again, let's say, 6, 7, 8, 9 seconds, 10 seconds on the mini progression,"
- vid-3EcXfOgjk1o @ 03:36 (Radoslav Radev): "and then the transition will be much easier, and you're not risking that much."
